column2:
訂位、預訂
例I made a reservation for 7 p.m.
影片I'd like to make a reservation for two.
補充搭配:make / cancel a reservation

容納;滿足(需求)
例The room accommodates ten guests.
影片Can you accommodate a large group? / Can you accommodate food allergies?
注意影片中兩種意思都出現

候位名單
例They put us on the waiting list.
影片Is there a waiting list?

服裝規定
例The club has a strict dress code.
影片Is there a dress code for the restaurant?

兒童餐椅
例We need a high chair for the baby.
影片Do you have high chairs for children?

搖晃不穩的
例Careful—that chair is wobbly.
影片This table is a bit wobbly. Can we get another one?

冷颼颼的
例It gets chilly at night.
影片It's a bit chilly here. Could we move to another table?

區域
例We sat in the no-smoking section.
影片Is there a quieter section we could move to?

人流、過往行人
例The shop gets a lot of foot traffic.
影片We prefer to sit somewhere with less foot traffic.

推薦
例Can you recommend a hotel?
影片What do you recommend?
補充名詞:recommendation

建議
例What do you suggest we do?
影片I'm looking for something light. What do you suggest?

開胃菜(appetizer 美式;starter 英式)
例We ordered two appetizers.
影片We would like to start with some appetizers. / Can you recommend a starter?

主菜
例The main course was lamb.
影片Can I have the salad as my main course?

配菜
例Rice is a common side dish.
影片Can I have a side of fries with that?

(一人)份量
例The portions here are huge.
影片How big are the portions?
補充half portion 半份、tasting portion 試吃份

今日特餐
例The waiter listed the specials.
影片What are today's specials?
補充另有 daily special、chef's special

招牌菜、特色菜
例Seafood is their specialty.
影片I'd like to try a local specialty. / What's the specialty of the house?

招牌的
例This is her signature dish.
影片What's your signature cocktail?
注意熟字生義:本義「簽名」→ 代表作

今日鮮魚
例The catch of the day is salmon.
影片What's the catch of the day?
注意catch 熟字生義:漁獲

拼盤
例We shared a cheese platter.
影片What's in the seafood platter?

替換
例You can substitute butter with oil.
影片Can I substitute the fries with a salad?

事先、提前
例Book at least a week in advance.
影片Can we order the cake in advance for a birthday?

概要、簡介
例He gave an overview of the plan.
影片Can we get a quick overview of the specials?

過敏的
例She's allergic to cats.
影片I'm allergic to peanuts.
補充固定搭配 be allergic to;名詞 allergy(Can you accommodate food allergies?)

含有
例This drink contains caffeine.
影片Does this dish contain any peanuts?

乳製品
例I avoid dairy.
影片Can you make this dish without dairy?
補充dairy-free 不含乳製品

乳糖不耐的
例Many adults are lactose intolerant.
影片I forgot to mention I'm lactose intolerant.

無麩質的
例sugar-free gum 無糖口香糖
影片Do you offer any gluten-free options? / Can you ensure our dishes are nut-free?
補充「-free」= 不含…:nut-free、dairy-free、sugar-free

素食者(的)
例He became a vegetarian.
影片I'm a vegetarian. Do you have vegetarian options?

純素(蛋奶也不吃)
例The cake is 100% vegan.
影片Do you have any vegan desserts?

有機的
例We buy organic vegetables.
影片Do you serve organic food?

(牛排)三分熟
例I like my steak medium rare.
影片I'll have the steak medium rare.
補充熟度:rare → medium rare → medium → medium well → well-done

油膩的
例Fried food is oily.
影片I'd like my meal to be less oily.

清淡的、輕食的
例I want a light lunch.
影片I'm looking for something light.
注意熟字生義:不只「輕的」

(餐點)豐盛的
例We had a hearty breakfast.
影片What are your best options for a hearty meal?

鹹味的(與甜相對)
例I prefer savory snacks.
影片Can we have a mix of sweet and savory for our breakfast?

清爽提神的
例a refreshing cold shower
影片What's a refreshing drink to pair with our meal?

有節慶氣氛的
例The streets look festive.
影片We're celebrating. Could you bring us something festive?

大膽嘗新的
例She's an adventurous eater.
影片Do you have a dish that is a bit adventurous?

很想吃、嘴饞
例I'm craving pizza.
影片I'm craving something sweet. What desserts do you have?

溫馨舒適的
例a cozy little café
影片We're looking for a cozy meal. Any suggestions?

餅皮、麵包皮
例I don't eat the crust.
影片Can the pizza be made with a thin crust?

加熱
例Let me heat up the soup.
影片Can you heat this up a little more?

飲料(較正式)
例Hot beverages are served all day.
影片Do you have any non-alcoholic beverages?
補充non-alcoholic 無酒精的

無酒精雞尾酒
例I ordered a mango mocktail.
影片Do you have a selection of mocktails?
補充mock(仿製)+ cocktail

侍酒師
例The sommelier suggested a Merlot.
影片Do you have a sommelier to recommend wine?
補充法文借字,拼法特殊

(酒菜)搭配
例Red wine pairs well with beef.
影片What's a good dish to pair with white wine? / a good wine to go with my meal
補充名詞:pairing(a good pairing for the ribeye steak)

一輪(全桌每人一杯)
例The first round is on me.
影片Can we order a round of drinks to start?

續杯
例Refills are free here.
影片Can I get a refill on my drink?

(一)壺
例a pitcher of iced tea
影片Could you bring a jug of tap water? / Can we have a pitcher of sangria?
注意pitcher 與 picture 發音極近

(啤酒)桶裝現壓的
例They have five beers on tap.
影片Do you have any local beer on tap?
補充比較:tap water 自來水

脫脂牛奶
例Skim milk has less fat.
影片I'd like my coffee with skim milk, please.

鮮榨的
例freshly squeezed orange juice
影片Do you have any freshly squeezed juices?

沙拉醬
例Caesar dressing 凱薩醬
影片Can we have the dressing on the side for the salad?
注意熟字生義:不是「穿衣」

(醬料)另外放、不要淋上
例Sauce on the side, please.
影片Could I have the dressing on the side?
補充影片最高頻句型之一

(烤肉)肉汁醬
例mashed potatoes with gravy
影片Can I have a little extra gravy on the side?

餐巾(紙)
例He wiped his mouth with a napkin.
影片Can we get some extra napkins?

什錦的、綜合的
例a box of assorted chocolates
影片Can we get a plate of assorted cheeses?
補充名詞 assortment(an assortment of your best desserts)

薄片
例a slice of bread
影片Can we have some extra lemon slices?

帳單(美式)
例The check came to $40.
影片Can I have the check, please?
注意熟字生義;英式用 bill

分攤帳單
例Let's split the bill evenly.
影片Could we split the bill?

服務費
例A 10% service charge applies.
影片Is service charge included in the bill?

免費招待的
例Breakfast is complimentary.
影片Is the bread basket complimentary?

讚美
例She complimented my cooking.
影片I would like to compliment the chef.
注意與 complimentary 同家族;勿與 complement(補充)混淆

折扣
例Students get a 20% discount.
影片Do you offer any discounts for large groups?

會員集點方案
例Join our loyalty program for points.
影片Do you have a loyalty program?
補充loyalty 忠誠

(酒吧)優惠時段
例Beers are half price during happy hour.
影片Is there a happy hour menu?

剩菜(恆用複數)
例We ate leftovers for lunch.
影片Can I take the leftovers home?

週年紀念日
例their tenth wedding anniversary
影片We're celebrating an anniversary. Can you do something special?
